summary: Requirements derived from stakeholder interviews for ticket triage summarization and ordering.

requirements.description: Repeated ticket IDs represent updates; keep only the last occurrence and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

sources.quote: Repeated IDs are updates: keep the last occurrence, and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

acceptance.given: A list of tickets containing multiple entries with identical IDs and different states
acceptance.then: Only the final occurrence of each ticket ID is evaluated, and tickets with a final state of closed are excluded from openCount, bySeverity, customerIds, and queue

requirements.description: Open tickets in the triage queue are ordered urgent before normal before low, breaking ties by ticket ID in ascending order.

sources.quote: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets; ties should use the ticket ID in ascending order.

acceptance.given: A collection of open tickets across urgent, normal, and low severities with various ticket IDs
acceptance.then: Tickets are ordered with urgent first, then normal, then low, and any ties within the same severity level are ordered by ascending ticket ID

requirements.description: The summary provides counts of open tickets by severity and lists each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

sources.quote: The summary must count open tickets by severity and list each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

acceptance.given: A collection of open tickets associated with various customer IDs across different severities
acceptance.then: bySeverity contains accurate counts for urgent, normal, and low tickets, and customerIds contains unique customer IDs sorted in ascending order

assumptions: Ticket string fields (id, title, customerId, severity, state) are trimmed, with severity and state evaluated case-insensitively.
Non-array ticket collections or malformed ticket objects will cause the process to reject with a TypeError.
Closed tickets are completely excluded from openCount, bySeverity counts, customerIds, and queue.
